## Question 1

```{r Question 1}
my_t <- function(x) {
  new_matrix <- matrix(nrow = ncol(x), ncol = nrow(x))
  for (i in 1:nrow(x)) {
    for (j in 1:ncol(x)) {
      new_matrix[j,i] <- x[i,j]
    }
  }
  new_matrix
}

```

## Question 2

### (a)
```{r Question 2a}
my_cor <- function(x, y, use = "everything") {
  xbar <- mean(x)
  ybar <- mean(y)
  diffx <- x-xbar
  diffy <- y-ybar
  diffx_2 <- (x-xbar)^2
  diffy_2 <- (y-ybar)^2
  
#  if (use == "everything") {
#    sum(diffx * diffy) / (sqrt(sum(diffx_2)) * sqrt(sum(diffy_2)))
#  }
  
  if (use == "pairwise.complete.obs") {
    x = x[!is.na(x) & !is.na(y)]
    y = y[!is.na(x) & !is.na(y)]
    
  }
  
  sum(diffx * diffy) / (sqrt(sum(diffx_2)) * sqrt(sum(diffy_2)))
  
}
```


```{r}
x <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
y <- c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6)
test <- my_cor(x,y,use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
test
real <- cor(x,y,use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
real
```

### (b)
```{r Question 2b}
linreg <- function(x,y,use = "everything"){
  
  if (use == "pairwise.complete.obs") {
    x <- x[!is.na(x) & !is.na(y)]
    y <- y[!is.na(x) & !is.na(y)]
  }
  
  b = my_cor(x,y) * (sd(y) / sd(x))
  a = mean(y) - (b * mean(x))
  c(a,b)
}
```

### (d)
```{r Question 2d}
linreg_mat <- function(x,y) {
  if (length(x) != length(y)){
    stop("Vector arguments must be of same length.")
  }
  X = matrix(data = c(rep(1,length(x)), x), nrow = length(x),ncol = 2)
  Xt <- my_t(X)
  ((Xt %*% X)^-1) %*% Xt %*% y
  solve
  # figure out hint 3
}
```

## Question 3

### (a)
```{r Question 3a}
`%m%` <- function(A,B) {
  m = nrow(A)
  n = ncol(A)
  p = ncol(B)
  
  C = matrix(0, ncol = p, nrow = m)
  if (ncol(A) == nrow(B)) {
    for (i in 1:m){
      for (j in 1:p){
        for (k in 1:n) {
          C[i,j] <- C[i,j] + (A[i, k] * B[k, j])
        }
      }
    }
    C
  }
  else {
    stop("Matrix arguments are not conformable.")
  }
}
```

## Question 4

### (a)
```{r Question 4a}
`%^%` <- function(A,k) {
  result = A
  num = 1
  while (num < k) {
    result = result %m% A
    num = num + 1 
  }
  result
}

```

## Question 5

```{r Question 5}
my_which <- function(x, arr.ind = FALSE) {
  if (arr.ind) {
    ind1 = 1
    result = matrix(nrow = sum(x), ncol = 2)
    for (i in 1:nrow(x)){
      for (j in 1:ncol(x)){
        if (x[i,j]) {
          result[ind1, 1] <- i
          result[ind1, 2] <- j
          ind1 = ind1 + 1
        }
      }
    }
  } else {
    index = 1
    result = c()
    for (i in seq_along(x)) {
      if (x[i]) {
        result[index] <- i
        index = index + 1
      }
    }
  }
  result
}
```

## Question 7

### (a)
```{r Question 7a}
my_row <- function(x) {
    output <- matrix(nrow = nrow(x), ncol = ncol(x))
    for (i in 1:nrow(x)){
      for (j in 1:ncol(x)){
        output[i,j] <- i
      }
    }
    output
}
```

### (b)
```{r Question 7b}
my_col <- function(x) {
    output <- matrix(nrow = nrow(x), ncol = ncol(x))
    for (i in 1:nrow(x)){
      for (j in 1:ncol(x)){
        output[i,j] <- j
      }
    }
    output
}

my_row(Z) == my_col(Z)
```

### (c)
```{r Question 7c}
my_diag <- function(x,nrow = nrow(x),ncol = nrow(x)) {
  output = c(sum((my_row(x) == my_col(x))))
  index = 1
  for (i in 1:nrow(x)) {
    if (my_row(x) == my_col(x)){
      output[index] <- x[i,i]
      index = index + 1
    }
  }
  output
}
```
